label: Technicolor TC4400 DOCSIS 3.1 cable modem
description: DOCSIS 3.1 cable modem with 2x2 OFDM(A) bonded channels and 32x8 DOCSIS 3.0 bonding, driving two 10/100/1000BASE-T LAN ports.
notes: Datasheet: '2 x 2 OFDM(A) bonded channels in DOCSIS 3.1 mode', '32 x 8 bonded channels in DOCSIS 3.0 mode', DOCSIS 3.1 downstream up to 3.6 Gbps (3.0 mode 1372 Mbps theoretical), 'Interfaces LAN: 2 10/100/1000 Base-T Ethernet ports', DS 54-1002 MHz / up to 204 MHz split. Discontinued but still widely deployed by MSOs, so the two-port bridge shape matters for topologies.
